name: Hive
description: Hive was a ransomware-as-a-service operation active June 2021 to January 2023, primarily targeting hospitals, schools, and public institutions. The group extorted over $100 million from more than 1,500 victims in 80 countries. The FBI covertly infiltrated Hive's network in mid-2022, obtaining decryption keys and providing them to victims before dismantling the group's infrastructure in January 2023.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Justice Disrupts Hive Ransomware — DOJ
